articles.summary: VICTOR, N.Y. – Broadstone Net Lease, Inc. (NYSE: BNL) (“BNL”, the “Company”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) announced today that it has added one additional build-to-suit development for Tesla, Inc, with an estimated total project investment of $39.8 million.
